nodes.title: 人物参考图 · 按图片顺序添加
本段提示词
widgets_values: Replace the subject with the character shown in <Picture 1>人物的面部特征参考<Picture 1><Picture 2>: a fair-skinned female, slender figure, slim waist, long black hair with vibrant pink highlights, wearing a black long-sleeved off-the-shoulder crop top, a pink pleated mini skirt, sheer tights, and black knee-high leather boots with metallic buckles. BACKGROUND: An outdoor rooftop setting with a clear blue sky and a distant city skyline. The new character must perfectly synchronize with the original video's body movements, gestures, facial expressions, eye gaze, and lip sync, maintaining stable identity and clothing from <Picture 1> in every frame.

nodes.title: 上一段成片 · 续段时连接
视频上下文用法
widgets_values:
首段：上一段视频留空，序号设为 1。

续段：加载上段成片，连接到生成节点的「上一段视频」；或直接连接前一个生成节点的「本段视频」。

视频仍接当前源素材。节点自动取上段尾部 22 帧与音频、添加引导并裁回本段目标时长。
